RemindWaiting: People v2 Mobile E5: "Remind-all is desktop only; each row has its own Remind or Fill in."
ImportTemplate: People v2 Mobile F1: "No template, kind filter or search on a phone."
WhatChangedAsk: People v2 Mobile G1: "The period control, follow-up and charts are desktop only."
AnalyticsExport: People v2 Mobile G2: "No CSV export on a phone."
SharedSummary: Opened from the link in the email it was sent with, which opens in the browser: the app has no universal links while it runs in Expo Go.
SharedSummaryPdf: Opened from the link in the email it was sent with, which opens in the browser: the app has no universal links while it runs in Expo Go.
CompleteChatApp: The chat app's approval returns to the company's web address, whose route finishes the connection; the app opens that approval in the browser and reads the result when it comes back.
ExportSharesToDecide: Not read by the web either: the Review queue reads ExportSharesWaiting, as the app does.
AssignTimeOffSchedule: Not called by the web either: no Time Off screen uses it yet, so neither does the app.
ChangeTimeOffLeaveType: Not called by the web either: no Time Off screen uses it yet, so neither does the app.
ImportTimeOffMembers: Not called by the web either: no Time Off screen uses it yet, so neither does the app.
PeopleInbox: Read for the phone too, by /api/mobile/inbox: the web's own merge of every module's Inbox, which the app asks instead of each module.
TimeOffInbox: Read for the phone too, by /api/mobile/inbox: the web's own merge of every module's Inbox, which the app asks instead of each module.
DocumentsInbox: Read for the phone too, by /api/mobile/inbox: the web's own merge of every module's Inbox, which the app asks instead of each module.
RenameDocument: Documents Mobile: the phone names a document when it is added (MD3); renaming afterwards is the web's.
SetDocumentExpiry: Documents Mobile MD3: Kithena reads the expiry when a scan is filed (Phase 3); setting it by hand is the web's.
RestoreDocument: Documents web H3: Deleted is a filter in the web's ⋯ menu; the phone has no Deleted view.
ChangeDocumentSection: Documents Mobile MD5 and MD6: the phone creates sections and shows them; moving documents between them is the web's row menu.
CancelDocumentRequest: Documents web H2: withdrawing a request HR made is on the web's person file; the phone reminds and asks (MH2, MH3).
PlaceLegalHold: Documents web H3: legal holds are placed from the web; the phone lists and lifts them (MS6).
ConfirmDocumentDeletion: Documents web H3: confirming deletion when retention ends is a desk task; the phone shows the To delete count (MH1).
SaveDocumentType: Documents Mobile MS2: the phone lists document types; editing a type's sentence is the web's (S3).
DocumentsEnvelopes: Documents Mobile MH6: on the phone HR's To sign tile filters the Documents tab in place; the list of every request is the web's (K10).
SealEnvelope: Documents web K8: sealing again after a seal that did not finish is the sender's recovery on the web.
SendForAcknowledgement: Documents web F2: sending a policy out is the web's; the phone acknowledges it and tracks it (MH5).
CompareDocumentVersions: Documents web D3: comparing two versions shows the redline beside the page, which needs the desk's width; the phone opens each version.
SuggestDocumentFiling: Documents Mobile MD3: the phone files scans, which are images, and Kithena reads PDFs only until it can read images (OCR); the web's upload sorts PDFs (C1).
DescribeDocumentType: Documents Mobile MS2: the phone lists document types; drafting one from words is part of editing a type, which is the web's (S3, S4).
